confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of northern Italian lakeside pricing, not live listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately certain. Accommodation is less certain because July lake-season rates vary widely by location and availability. The FX observation is not the latest available: the most recent RBA figure I could verify is dated 2025-12-31, about ten months before the 2026-10-16 generation date. The server should refresh the FX observation from the RBA F11.1 table before converting any AUD values.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on mid-sized northern Italian cities near Milan, such as Bergamo and Verona, with a summer tourism premium on lodging and drinks similar to other Italian lake towns like Lecco and Bellagio.
